dogecoin.text:
@elonmusk When we talk about efficiency...  

Dogecoin ($DOGE):  
- Energy Consumption: Higher due to Proof of Work (PoW), but less than Bitcoin; around 100 wh per transaction.   
- CO2 Emissions: Significant due to energy use, though exact figures can vary based on electricity source; https://t.co/OP2ZvELwEy
